title: Spicy Ethiopian Chicken Wot
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish made with chicken cooked in a spicy wot sauce, served with a side of egg and a hearty accompaniment.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the Ethiopian wot sauce and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the beaten eggs and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over a hearty accompaniment, such as injera bread or rice.
